rationale: First-order self-draining heater with K~1.0, tau~155s. E1-E2-E5 show u=0.5 settles >0.534, E6 shows u=0.4 settles <0.495, E7-E8 prove (u=0.45,y=0.497) is a measured equilibrium held flat 240s. Hence u* for 0.5 is 0.45-0.46: use feed-forward (target-0.05)/0.99. PI trims residual: Kp=1.8 gives fast initial drive without second-order overshoot (first-order has no momentum, switching to u* is bumpless), Ti=Kp/Ki=120s ~ tau for IMC-like cancellation, lambda~50-80s. Integral gated to |e|<0.10 and clamped to +-0.15 authority to cover 5x observed ff error while preventing windup during far transient. 8s measurement filter suppresses 0.005 quantization without adding lag vs 155s plant. Output clamped [0,0.75] keeps y far from 0.9 cutoff and saves energy; high-y safety forces cooling.

extra.machine_card: Heater: positive gain, more power = hotter. Gain K~0.99 per unit u, ambient ~0.05 (15C+3C). Equilibrium: u=0.45 holds y=0.497 measured 240s flat; u=0.5 settles ~0.55 overshooting target, so u* for 0.5 is ~0.453. Speed: tau~150-160s (E1 0.05->0.395 in 180s, E3 0.497->0.196 in 179s), needs 250-320s to settle, max rate ~0.005/s per 0.5u (~0.006 per 1u). Lag: first-order monotonic, no overshoot, no dead-time, no dead-zone. Self-draining: u=0 cools on its own toward 0.05. Noise: small <0.01 pk-pk, quantization steps ~0.005-0.006.
extra.predicted_behavior: From cold 0.05: full 0.75 for ~100s, enters 0.475 band in ~140-170s, converges without overshoot, inside band by ~200-250s and stays. From hot: coasts with u=0 then recovers. Steady state: y=0.50+-0.01, u=0.45-0.47 (ff 0.454 + small integral). No oscillation, overshoot <0.01 above target in true state, energy near minimum steady power.
